How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Guwahati Research Associate Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 18-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Guwahati to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Research Associate position at IIT Guwahati?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Research Associate position at IIT Guwahati is 18th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Research Associate position will receive a salary of Rs. 58,000 per month.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a PhD degree in Biosciences and Bioengineering, Chemical Engineering, Biotechnology, or Material Science and Engineering to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Associate position will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Research Associate at IIT Guwahati.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online for the Research Associate position through the official IIT Guwahati website.

faq.question: Q8. Where is IIT Guwahati located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati is located in Guwahati, Assam, with the pincode 781039.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is IITG/II&SI/Project Staff Rectt-2026/151.

faq.question: Q10. When is the interview date for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The interview for the Research Associate position is scheduled to be held on 21st September 2026.
